en-US.title: A 10-year-old baseball prodigy I met in Japan… Shocking! Is this what talent looks like?
en-US.description:

Despite his young age, his judgment of batted balls, footwork, and throwing were truly impressive; it was a moment when I immediately understood why he is called a genius. I am even more excited to see how much he will grow in the future!

From his very first play:

✔️ Judgment in reading the direction of batted balls

✔️ Flawless footwork

✔️ Fast and accurate throws

All of this was unbelievable for someone his age of 10.

What was particularly impressive was not his ‘technique,’ but

👉 the fact that his sense of understanding baseball itself is already close to perfection.

It wasn't just a matter of him being good;

It was a moment when I immediately understood why he is evaluated as a “genius” in Japan. I am really looking forward to seeing how much he will grow in the future, and how far this player will go🔥
